attempts.sql: SELECT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id WHERE s.file_id = 'src/click/_compat.py' AND s.kind = 'function' AND s.is_public = TRUE AND (s.summary IS NULL OR s.summary = '') ORDER BY s.symbol_id

request:
